_views.text: Orbital_System is the circular/orbital visual renderer of Luna. Written in pure Rust compiled to WASM via Leptos 0.6. Zero JavaScript — the entire renderer from UI to Canvas runs in Rust/WASM. It renders the Nucleus as a pulsating circle at center (250,250), its color and radius driven by NucleusState and pulsation bpm. Three sprites orbit at 60fps: Aether (pink, 30°/s), Lumina (cyan, -45°/s), Solaris (yellow, 20°/s). When a sprite enters superposé state, Gaussian blur and ghost double are applied. Colors follow the 5-color palette. Orbital paths match sprite colors. Orbital_System does not contain Luna — it visualizes Luna. It is swappable: Graph_System or Particle_System could replace it without touching Visual_System.
